If sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is strongly negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to counteract pessimism.  
For mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67), apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment if recent price trend is declining.  
For late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is positive but price is trending downward, apply a 1.0–1.5% upward adjustment to capture reversal potential.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, reduce forecast slope by 0.1–0.3% per day for late horizon to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, increase forecast slope by 0.1–0.3% per day for late horizon to avoid underestimating downside risk.
